note: Example sentences written for this project; vocabulary limited to the Cambridge Pre A1 Starters, A1 Movers and A2 Flyers wordlists. Audio: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), voices bm_lewis (UK) / af_heart (US).

w0.en: A black beetle is walking on the leaf.
w0.zh: 一隻黑色的甲蟲在葉子上走。

w1.en: The butterfly has got orange and black wings.
w1.zh: 這隻蝴蝶有橘色和黑色的翅膀。
w1.pic: The butterfly has got blue wings.
w1.pzh: 這隻蝴蝶有藍色的翅膀。
w1.pfalse: The butterfly has got yellow wings.

w2.en: The camel can walk across the desert for days.
w2.zh: 駱駝可以穿越沙漠走好幾天。

w3.en: We found a strange creature in the pond.
w3.zh: 我們在池塘裡發現一隻奇怪的生物。

w4.en: This dinosaur was bigger than a bus!

w5.en: The eagle is flying high above the mountains.

w6.en: Dinosaurs are extinct, so we can only see them in museums.
w6.zh: 恐龍已經絕種了，所以我們只能在博物館看到牠們。

w7.en: My cat has got soft white fur.
w7.zh: 我的貓有柔軟的白色毛。

w8.en: The rabbit is small and furry.
w8.zh: 這隻兔子小小的、毛茸茸的。

w9.en: A bee is an insect with six legs.
w9.zh: 蜜蜂是有六隻腳的昆蟲。

w10.en: There are three eggs in the bird's nest.
w10.pic: There are two eggs in the nest.
w10.pfalse: There are four eggs in the nest.

w11.en: An octopus has got eight long arms.

w12.en: A white swan is swimming on the lake.
w12.zh: 一隻白天鵝在湖上游泳。

w13.en: The tortoise is very old and very slow.
w13.zh: 這隻陸龜很老，走得很慢。

w14.en: Lions and tigers are wild animals.
w14.zh: 獅子和老虎是野生動物。

w15.en: The bird hurt its wing, so it can't fly.
w15.zh: 這隻鳥的翅膀受傷了，所以不能飛。

w16.en: I fell off my bike and hurt my elbow.
w16.zh: 我從腳踏車上摔下來，撞傷了手肘。

w17.en: She's wearing a ring on her finger.

w18.en: He's got a bandage on his knee.

w19.en: The water is cold! I can feel it with my toes.
w19.zh: 水好冰！我的腳趾感覺得到。

w20.en: Dad is wearing a brown belt with his jeans.
w20.zh: 爸爸的牛仔褲搭配一條棕色皮帶。

w21.en: My aunt gave me a silver bracelet for my birthday.
w21.zh: 阿姨送我一條銀手鍊當生日禮物。

w22.en: I'm wearing a pirate costume to the party.
w22.zh: 我穿著海盜裝去參加派對。

w23.en: The queen has got a gold crown on her head.
w23.zh: 女王頭上戴著金色的皇冠。

w24.en: It's cold, so put on your gloves.
w24.zh: 天氣很冷，戴上你的手套。

w25.en: Mum is wearing a beautiful necklace tonight.
w25.zh: 媽媽今晚戴著一條漂亮的項鍊。

w26.en: It's time for bed. Put on your pyjamas!
w26.zh: 該睡覺了，穿上你的睡衣！

w27.en: I've got a key in my pocket.
w27.zh: 我的口袋裡有一把鑰匙。

w28.en: The queen is wearing a gold ring.

w29.en: It's very sunny today. Where are my sunglasses?
w29.zh: 今天太陽好大，我的太陽眼鏡在哪裡？
w29.pzh: 這副太陽眼鏡是黑色的。

w30.en: I wear my trainers when I play basketball.
w30.zh: 我打籃球的時候穿運動鞋。
w30.pzh: 這是一隻藍色的運動鞋。

w31.en: Take an umbrella. It's going to rain.

w32.en: At my school, we wear a blue uniform.
w32.zh: 我們學校穿藍色的制服。
w32.pic: The boy is wearing a uniform.

w33.en: The winner got a gold cup.
w33.zh: 冠軍得到一座金色的獎盃。

w34.en: Grandma has got a silver watch.
w34.zh: 奶奶有一支銀色的手錶。

w35.en: There's a spot of paint on your T-shirt.
w35.zh: 你的 T 恤上有一個油漆點。
w35.pic: There are lots of red spots on the yellow paper.
w35.pzh: 黃色的紙上有很多紅色的點點。
w35.pfalse: There are lots of green spots on the yellow paper.

w36.en: I've got a red spotted umbrella.
w36.zh: 我有一把紅色的點點雨傘。
w36.pic: This insect is red with black spots.
w36.pzh: 這隻昆蟲是紅色的，有黑色的點點。
w36.pfalse: This insect is green with black spots.

w37.en: The tiger has got black stripes.
w37.pic: There are red and blue stripes.
w37.pfalse: There are green and yellow stripes.

w38.en: He's wearing a blue and white striped shirt.
w38.zh: 他穿著一件藍白條紋的襯衫。
w38.pzh: 這是一件條紋 T 恤。

w39.en: Her husband is a doctor at the hospital.
w39.zh: 她的丈夫是醫院的醫生。

w40.en: My aunt and uncle got married last summer.
w40.zh: 我的阿姨和姨丈去年夏天結婚了。

w41.en: My surname is Brown, like my dad's.
w41.zh: 我姓布朗，跟我爸爸一樣。

w42.en: Mr Brown and his wife live next to us.
w42.zh: 布朗先生和他的太太住在我們隔壁。

w43.en: Can I have a chocolate biscuit, please?
w43.zh: 請問我可以吃一塊巧克力餅乾嗎？

w44.en: I like butter and jam on my bread.
w44.zh: 我喜歡在麵包上塗奶油和果醬。

w45.en: I eat cereal with milk for breakfast.
w45.zh: 我早餐吃加牛奶的穀片。

w46.en: Can you eat noodles with chopsticks?

w47.en: We need flour, eggs and sugar to make a cake.
w47.zh: 做蛋糕需要麵粉、蛋和糖。
w47.pic: This is a bag of flour.
w47.pfalse: This is a bag of sugar.

w48.en: Please put a knife and fork on the table.
w48.zh: 請把刀子和叉子放在桌上。

w51.en: Be careful! Don't cut your finger with that knife.
w51.zh: 小心！別被那把刀割到手指。

w52.en: Breakfast is my favourite meal of the day.
w52.zh: 早餐是我一天中最喜歡的一餐。
w52.pic: There's a fork and a knife next to the plate.
w52.pzh: 盤子旁邊有一支叉子和一把刀子。
w52.pfalse: There's a spoon next to the plate.

w53.en: There are green olives on the pizza.

w54.en: Can you give me the salt and pepper?
w54.zh: 可以把鹽和胡椒給我嗎？

w55.en: Would you like a piece of cake?

w56.en: We're having pizza for dinner tonight.
w56.pic: This is a piece of pizza.
w56.pfalse: This is a piece of cake.

w58.pic: This person is smelling a flower.
w58.pfalse: This person is eating a flower.

w59.en: I have a snack after school.

w60.en: You need a spoon to eat your soup.

w61.en: This strawberry is big and red.

w62.en: Do you want sugar in your tea?
w62.pic: There are six pieces of sugar.
w62.pfalse: There are ten pieces of sugar.

w65.en: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
w65.zh: 護士在我的手臂上包了繃帶。

w66.en: Mum bought some medicine at the chemist's.
w66.zh: 媽媽在藥局買了一些藥。

w67.en: I've got a cut on my finger.
w67.zh: 我的手指上有一道傷口。

w68.en: Be careful on the ice or you'll fall over.
w68.zh: 在冰上要小心，不然會跌倒。

w69.en: Take this medicine and you'll feel better.
w69.zh: 吃了這個藥你就會好一點。
w69.pic: This medicine is red and yellow.
w69.pzh: 這顆藥是紅色和黃色的。
w69.pfalse: This medicine is blue and green.

w70.en: The doctor looked at the x-ray of my leg.
w70.zh: 醫生看了我腿部的 X 光片。
w70.pzh: 這是一張 X 光片。

w71.en: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.

w72.en: She combs her long hair every morning.
w72.zh: 她每天早上梳她的長髮。

w73.en: Dad is making soup on the cooker.

w74.en: There's a soft cushion on the sofa.
w74.zh: 沙發上有一個軟軟的靠墊。

w75.en: I write in my diary every night.

w76.en: Meet me at the entrance of the zoo.
w76.zh: 在動物園的入口和我碰面。

w77.en: Put the letter in an envelope.

w78.en: The milk is in the fridge.

w79.en: Close the gate, or the dog will run away.
w79.zh: 把大門關上，不然狗會跑走。

w80.en: I can't find the key to the front door.

w81.en: I wrote a letter to my grandpa.

w82.en: The cake is in the oven.

w83.en: Don't sit too near the screen.

w84.en: I wash my hair with shampoo.

w85.en: Put the books back on the shelf, please.
w85.pic: There are books on the shelf.
w85.pfalse: There are shoes on the shelf.

w86.en: Wash your hands with soap and water.

w87.en: You need a stamp to post this letter.
w87.zh: 要寄這封信需要貼郵票。
w87.pic: There's a bird on this stamp.
w87.pfalse: There's a fish on this stamp.

w88.en: Sit on the step and take off your shoes.
w88.zh: 坐在台階上把鞋子脫掉。

w89.en: The children are playing on the swings.
w89.pic: The girl is on a swing.
w89.pfalse: The girl is on a bike.

w90.en: The telephone is ringing. Can you answer it?
w90.zh: 電話響了，你可以接一下嗎？

w91.en: Betty is the oldest girl in our class.
w91.zh: 貝蒂是我們班上年紀最大的女生。

w92.en: David likes playing chess with his dad.
w92.zh: 大衛喜歡和爸爸下西洋棋。

w93.en: Emma wants to be a pilot one day.
w93.zh: 艾瑪希望有一天能當飛行員。

w94.en: Frank is learning to play the drums.

w95.en: George forgot his backpack at school.
w95.zh: 喬治把書包忘在學校了。

w96.en: Harry is the fastest runner in the team.
w96.zh: 哈利是隊上跑得最快的人。

w97.en: Helen sent me a letter from London.
w97.zh: 海倫從倫敦寄了一封信給我。

w98.en: Holly has got a big spotted dog.

w99.en: Katy is wearing a costume for the festival.
w99.zh: 凱蒂為了節慶活動穿上戲服。

w100.en: Michael wants to be an astronaut.

w103.en: Robert broke his arm last winter.
w103.zh: 羅伯特去年冬天摔斷了手臂。

w104.en: Sarah won a prize in the competition.

w105.en: Sophia is studying history in the library.
w105.zh: 蘇菲亞正在圖書館讀歷史。

w106.en: William plays the violin in the school concert.
w106.zh: 威廉在學校音樂會上拉小提琴。

w107.en: We're going to the airport to catch a plane.
w107.pic: There's a plane at the airport.

w108.en: My aunt works in a bank in the city.
w108.zh: 我阿姨在城裡的銀行工作。

w109.en: We walked across the bridge over the river.

w110.en: The queen lives in a big castle.
w110.zh: 女王住在一座大城堡裡。
w110.pic: This castle has got red flags.
w110.pzh: 這座城堡有紅色的旗子。
w110.pfalse: This castle has got blue flags.

w111.en: I go to a chess club on Fridays.
w111.zh: 我每週五去參加西洋棋社。

w112.en: My big sister studies art at college.

w113.en: The bank is on the corner of the street.

w114.en: The sun comes up in the east.

w115.en: My uncle works in a car factory.
w115.zh: 我叔叔在汽車工廠工作。

w116.en: The fire engine is at the fire station.
w116.pic: There's a fire engine at the fire station.
w116.pzh: 消防局裡有一輛消防車。
w116.pfalse: There's a taxi at the fire station.

w117.en: Let's sit at the front of the bus.
w117.zh: 我們坐在公車的前面吧。

w118.en: How do I get to the museum?

w119.en: We stayed in a hotel near the beach.
w119.zh: 我們住在海灘附近的旅館。

w120.en: My school is two kilometres from my house.
w120.zh: 我的學校離我家兩公里。

w121.en: Turn left at the end of the street.

w122.en: London is a big city with lots of museums.
w122.zh: 倫敦是一座有很多博物館的大城市。

w123.en: There's a big tree in the middle of the park.
w123.zh: 公園的中間有一棵大樹。

w124.en: We saw a dinosaur at the museum.
w124.zh: 我們在博物館看到恐龍。

w125.en: It's very cold in the north in winter.

w126.en: Follow the path through the forest.
w126.pic: There's a path through the grass.

w127.en: The police officer took us to the police station.

w128.en: I'm going to the post office to buy some stamps.

w129.en: We had pizza at a restaurant near the beach.
w129.zh: 我們在海灘附近的餐廳吃披薩。

w130.en: The library is on the right.

w131.en: You can see the city from the skyscraper.
w131.zh: 從摩天大樓上可以看到整座城市。

w132.en: Birds fly south in the autumn.

w133.en: Thousands of people watched the match at the stadium.
w133.zh: 好幾千人在體育場看比賽。

w134.en: Go straight on and the park is in front of you.
w134.zh: 一直往前走，公園就在你前面。

w135.en: We saw a play at the theatre.
w135.zh: 我們在劇院看了一齣戲。

w136.en: My cousin is a student at the university.
w136.zh: 我的表哥是這所大學的學生。

w137.en: Is this the way to the station?

w138.en: The sun goes down in the west.

w139.en: Art is my favourite subject because I love painting.
w139.zh: 美術是我最喜歡的科目，因為我很愛畫畫。

w140.en: I put my books in my backpack.

w141.en: Please put the old paper in the bin.

w142.en: I won first prize in the drawing competition.
w142.zh: 我在繪畫比賽中得到第一名。
w142.pic: The children are in a running competition.
w142.pzh: 孩子們在參加賽跑比賽。
w142.pfalse: The children are in a swimming competition.

w143.en: Look up the word in your dictionary.

w144.en: There's a flag on the castle.

w145.en: In geography, we learn about rivers and mountains.
w145.zh: 我們在地理課學習河流和山脈。

w146.en: Glue the picture on the paper.

w147.en: We worked in a group of four.
w147.zh: 我們四個人一組一起做。

w148.en: We play basketball in the school gym.
w148.zh: 我們在學校體育館打籃球。

w149.en: In history, we learn about people from the past.
w149.zh: 我們在歷史課學習過去的人。

w150.zh: 英文是一種重要的語言。

w152.en: I like playing games online with my friends.
w152.zh: 我喜歡和朋友一起在網路上玩遊戲。

w153.en: Our class is doing a project about the ocean.
w153.zh: 我們班正在做一個關於海洋的專題。

w154.en: We learn about plants and animals in science.
w154.zh: 我們在自然課學習植物和動物。

w155.en: Cut the paper with your scissors.

w156.en: There are thirty students in my class.
w156.zh: 我們班上有三十個學生。
w156.pic: The student is wearing a black hat.
w156.pzh: 這個學生戴著一頂黑色的帽子。
w156.pfalse: The student is wearing a white hat.

w157.en: I need to study tonight because I've got an English quiz tomorrow.
w157.zh: 我今晚要讀書，因為明天有英文小考。

w158.en: What's your favourite subject at school?
w158.zh: 你在學校最喜歡什麼科目？

w159.en: Look at the timetable. We've got music after lunch.
w159.zh: 看看課表，我們午餐後有音樂課。

w160.en: My little brother watches cartoons on Saturday morning.
w160.zh: 我弟弟星期六早上看卡通。
w160.pic: There's a rabbit in this cartoon.
w160.pzh: 這部卡通裡有一隻兔子。
w160.pfalse: There's a cat in this cartoon.

w162.en: Grandpa taught me how to play chess.

w163.en: I collect stamps from all over the world.
w163.zh: 我收集世界各地的郵票。

w164.en: We went to a pop concert in the park.
w164.zh: 我們去公園看了一場流行音樂會。
w164.pic: A woman is singing at this concert.
w164.pzh: 一位女生在這場音樂會上唱歌。
w164.pfalse: A man is singing at this concert.

w165.en: He's playing the drum very loudly.
w165.pic: This drum is red and white.
w165.pzh: 這個鼓是紅色和白色的。
w165.pfalse: This drum is green and white.

w166.en: There's a music festival in our town every summer.
w166.zh: 我們鎮上每年夏天都有音樂節。

w167.en: It's dark in the cave. Turn on your torch!
w167.zh: 洞穴裡很暗，打開你的手電筒！

w168.en: My grandpa plays golf every Sunday.
w168.zh: 我爺爺每個星期天打高爾夫球。

w169.en: The piano is my favourite instrument.
w169.zh: 鋼琴是我最喜歡的樂器。

w170.en: I got an invitation to Katy's birthday party.
w170.zh: 我收到凱蒂生日派對的邀請函。

w171.en: I want to join the swimming club.

w172.en: Mum is reading a magazine about cooking.
w172.zh: 媽媽正在看一本烹飪雜誌。
w172.pic: There's a woman on this magazine.
w172.pzh: 這本雜誌上有一位女生。
w172.pfalse: There's a dog on this magazine.

w173.en: Our team won the football match!

w174.en: Let's meet at the café at four o'clock.
w174.zh: 我們四點在咖啡館碰面吧。

w175.en: I'm a member of the school chess club.
w175.zh: 我是學校西洋棋社的社員。

w176.en: My sister listens to pop music all day.
w176.zh: 我姊姊整天都在聽流行音樂。

w177.en: The winner of the race gets a prize.
w177.zh: 賽跑的冠軍會得到獎品。
w177.pic: This prize is a gold cup.
w177.pzh: 這個獎品是一座金色的獎盃。
w177.pfalse: This prize is a silver cup.

w178.en: This TV programme is about animals in the ocean.
w178.zh: 這個電視節目在介紹海洋動物。

w179.en: This puzzle has got five hundred pieces.

w180.en: We made a sand pyramid on the beach.
w180.zh: 我們在海灘上堆了一座沙金字塔。

w181.en: Our class won the music quiz.
w181.zh: 我們班贏了音樂問答比賽。

w182.en: Let's have a race to the tree!
w182.zh: 我們來比賽跑到那棵樹吧！
w182.pic: This flag is black and white.
w182.pfalse: This flag is red and white.

w183.zh: 爸爸喜歡大聲的搖滾樂。

w184.en: What's the score? Is it two – one?
w184.zh: 現在比數多少？是二比一嗎？

w185.en: We're going to ski in the mountains this winter.
w185.zh: 我們今年冬天要去山上滑雪。

w186.en: The children are sledging down the hill.
w186.zh: 孩子們正坐雪橇滑下山坡。

w187.en: My brother threw a snowball at me!
w187.zh: 我哥哥朝我丟了一顆雪球！

w188.en: I want a new snowboard for my birthday.
w188.zh: 我生日想要一塊新的滑雪板。

w189.en: Snowboarding is exciting, but it's difficult.
w189.zh: 單板滑雪很刺激，但是很難。

w190.en: We made a big snowman in the garden.
w190.zh: 我們在花園裡堆了一個大雪人。
w190.pic: The snowman has got a black hat.
w190.pzh: 雪人戴著一頂黑色的帽子。
w190.pfalse: The snowman has got a red hat.

w191.en: The singer is dancing on the stage.

w192.en: Put your clothes in the suitcase. We're leaving tomorrow.
w192.zh: 把衣服放進行李箱，我們明天出發。

w193.en: There are eleven players in a football team.
w193.zh: 一支足球隊有十一名球員。

w194.en: We slept in a tent when we went camping.
w194.zh: 我們去露營的時候睡在帳篷裡。

w195.en: I can play this tune on the guitar.
w195.zh: 我會用吉他彈這首曲子。

w196.en: Dad is changing the tyre on the car.
w196.zh: 爸爸正在換車子的輪胎。

w197.en: She plays the violin in the school concert.
w197.zh: 她在學校音樂會上拉小提琴。

w198.en: We play volleyball on the beach.

w199.pic: The winner is holding a gold cup.
w199.pzh: 冠軍拿著一座金色的獎盃。
w199.pfalse: The winner is holding a flag.

w200.en: I get up at seven a.m. every day.

w201.en: We moved to this town two years ago.
w201.zh: 我們兩年前搬到這個鎮上。

w202.en: The leaves turn red and yellow in autumn.
